I posted the draft as a thread reply to your message in #strategic-random. Nothing was sent to Mateo or procurement.

- First reported: 10:42 AM, gate kiosks offline and both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM, with trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM, per your post in #inc-vtg-hartford.

The draft also notes that kiosk 2 was kept powered on for reconnect testing and that status-page access for Mateo's account is still open under INC-4821.
